title: anerp: an agent-native headless ERP kernel
description: A headless ERP kernel whose only public surface is typed business-operation tools over MCP and a task-level agent over A2A; every write is two-phase, idempotent, receipted, policy-checked and event-emitting on one double-entry ledger. Each release archives the evaluation harness and the committed results — the tier-matched matrix (two tool surfaces, three vendors, 20 tasks, 3 runs), the three resilience experiments, and the reproducibility appendix REPRODUCIBILITY.md, which records the exact commit, models, seed and commands for each. See the release notes for what a given version adds.
